Samir - AE: Hi team — quick sync. Customer (FinRegCo) wants a POC but they require all processing and egress to remain within the EU. They also want KMS keys in eu-west-1 and a list of certified subprocessors before kickoff. Can we confirm options and any pricing delta for geo-pinning?

Priya - Solutions Eng: @Samir yep. We have three realistic patterns:
1) Tenant pinning to an EU-only pool (preferred)
2) Per-request region header with routing policy (works for mixed traffic)
3) Dedicated Private (VPC) with on-prem-ish flow if they need fully managed private infra :+1:

Lena - Sales Eng: Pricing question from the customer: if we do tenant pinning vs per-request routing, how do we bill? is there a minimum reserved cost?

Priya - Solutions Eng: Tenant pinning usually requires Dedicated/reserved capacity pricing for predictable throughput. Per-request routing can stay on Hosted but expect extra egress + regional multiplier for locked region. Short answer: tenant pinning -> commit tiers, per-request -> usage pricing + small regional surcharge. I can pull numbers after lunch.

Samir - AE: Customer also asked for subprocessors list and certs (ISO, SOC2). Who owns that?

Maya - Legal: We have a subprocessors inventory doc and an assurance pack. I can share the latest PDF and a short attestation, but note that APAC edge partners are not used for EU-only tenants. I need to confirm the KMS flow (do we bring-your-own-key or we host keys?).

Priya - Solutions Eng: We support both BYOK (via KMS/HSM integration) and Redwood-managed keys. For BYOK we can accept a customer-managed key in eu-west-1 and configure route so plaintext never leaves that region. Audit logs are available at retention X days (we can change w/ add-on).

Samir - AE: Customer demands routing policy example and a config snippet they can review. Can you post a minimal example?

Priya - Solutions Eng: Sure — tiny example we use in POCs:
```json
{
  "routing_policy": "geo_affinity",
  "allowed_regions": ["eu-west-1", "eu-central-1"],
  "tenant_pin": "eu-only",
  "fallback": { "target": "eu-compat-model", "max_latency_ms": 200 },
  "kms_key_id": "arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01"
}
```
This enforces EU-only routing and pins the tenant. Fallback routes to a compatible quantized model in the same region to keep SLA.

Lena - Sales Eng: Nice. Ops question: how long to onboard subprocessors and get the cert attestation? customer wants timeline for legal review before POC starts next sprint.

Maya - Legal: I can turn around a subprocessors inventory + SOC2 scoping statement within 48 hours. Full vendor cert proofs sometimes take longer (we may provide redacted certs and a point of contact). If they need contract addenda (DPA with subprocessor list) add ~5 business days.

Samir - AE: Any blockers from infra side for EU-only POC?

OpsBot: Deployment check OK: EU reserved pool capacity available next week (slots: 2). No outstanding infra tickets.

Priya - Solutions Eng: Only thing to decide is BYOK vs Redwood-managed keys. BYOK adds ~1 day ops config, managed keys are instantaneous. Also confirm whether they need IP allowlist or VPC peering for egress (VPC peering = more setup).

Samir - AE: Customer asks about cost delta estimate for tenant pinning (1 R5 GPU pool for small bursty workload) vs hosted geo-route. Can you provide a rough % delta?

Lena - Sales Eng: Ballpark: tenant pinning (dedicated) ~2.5-3x hosted for low util workloads because of reserved commit overhead. For sustained usage it becomes cheaper per-token. I'll draft a clear compare table for the call.

Maya - Legal: Also pro-tip for them: include a short security questionnaire item for key ownership and subprocessor access controls. I can pre-fill their standard 40Q sec questionnaire this afternoon.

Samir - AE: Great. Next steps: Priya to produce routing config + ops checklist; Lena to prepare pricing delta table; Maya to send subprocessors pack + prefilled sec Q. I'll schedule POC kickoff for next Thu if all good.

Priya - Solutions Eng: On it. I'll attach the sample routing policy doc and checklist in the POC Confluence and ping here when done :eyes:

Lena - Sales Eng: I'll share a draft pricing slide by EOD.

Maya - Legal: Sending inventory now.

Samir - AE: Thanks team — looping in the customer with this summary after you drop artifacts.

OpsBot: Note: create-poc-ticket #POC-4821 created and assigned to @Priya.
